summary.en: A real print in a neutral card mount on the desk: a shadow on the desk, a 54 px bar naming its source in mono, the 16:9 crop round its focus, its index numeral on the plane behind.
summary.zh: 桌上中性卡纸框里的一张真实截图：桌面上的投影，54 像素的标题栏用等宽字写来源，按焦点裁成 16:9，后层印着它的编号。

fits: Any real asset that must be shown untouched with its source named.
notFor: Drawn UIs; assets that need to be read in full detail (crop instead).

intent.en: Every print gets the same mount, so the evidence is compared like with like and every move rests on one frame.
intent.zh: 每张截图同一种框，证据之间才能同等比较，所有运镜也落在同一个画框上。

content.en: A real capture (crop and focus in its own px) and its source line (≤ 56 chars / 28 字).
content.zh: 一张真实截图（按它自己的像素给裁切和焦点）和来源行（≤ 56 字符 / 28 字）。

fits.zh: 要原样展示并写明来源的任何真实素材。

notFor.zh: 画出来的界面；需要看清全部细节的素材（先裁切）。

en: Never past 1.333 output px per source px: crop tighter instead of zooming.
zh: 输出像素与源像素之比不超过 1.333：要放大就先裁小。

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
